title: OrganizerMediaObjectsStoragePath
description: Stable organizer gallery media stored at organizers/{organizerId}/media/{mediaId}/{fileName}; gallery order lives in Firestore rather than object names.
x-storage-read: public for original and thumbnail objects
x-storage-write: active organizer owner or manager may create/delete original images; updates denied; thumbnails server only

mediaId.description: Stable random media identity independent of gallery position.
